description: This file declares the interface for the EcuAb_Gpt module, including initialization, control, query, notification, and mode functions for a General Purpose Timer component in an ECU abstraction layer.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_StartTicks
methods.description: Starts the timer on specified channel with given tick count.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_Stop
methods.description: Stops the timer on the specified channel.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_GetElapsed
methods.description: Returns the elapsed ticks for the specified channel.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_GetRemaining
methods.description: Returns the remaining ticks for the specified channel.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_RegisterCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for the specified channel.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_EnableNotification
methods.description: Enables notifications for the specified channel.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_DisableNotification
methods.description: Disables notifications for the specified channel.

methods.name: EcuAb_Gpt_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of the GPT.
